verdict_note: From reading only: no build, no clippy, no test. Line anchors are crates/hsk-studio-harness-view/src/view/prototype.rs at 2adb7501 unless a file is named. The mechanism holds. render_with checks the caller's token first (:914), before the session read, the cache and every step. frame_raster_under, smart_raster_under and directional_raster_under take the caller's token for every interop-fig and press call (:814-815, :861-869, :884-886). No self.cancel is read on the render_with path: self.cancel appears only in the four token-less wrappers (:792, :835, :879, :906). The capture forms and start_session pass v.cancel per call (commands/prototype.rs:86-88, :109-111 with :125, :162). A cancelled render inserts nothing into rendered or smart_cache, because both inserts follow a successful render back. Press returns Err(Canceled) when its painter saw the cancel (press-write export/render.rs:157-159), not a partial raster. The red log shows exactly the four new tests failing, and the red tests are unchanged at the tip. One medium defect makes builder claim 3 false. refused() (:93-98) does not type a cancel that to_native's Folio validations see, and Folio returns that cancel as FigError::NativeRejected(Code::Canceled). It surfaces as smart_native_refused or fig_native_refused, detail native_rejected, and the capture job settles failed (F1). The fix is one match arm and one test. F2 and F3 close the builder's two not-proven items cheaply. F4 is resolved by Q1. F5 is pre-existing and outside the owned paths. F6 is a note.

findings.where: view/prototype.rs:93-98 refused(); :575-576 open_document_with to_native; :861-862 smart_raster_under to_native; module doc :38-47
findings.what: to_native runs six Folio validations under the caller's token after its mapping walk. A cancel they see comes back as FigError::NativeRejected(hsk_studio_folio::Code::Canceled), and its code() is native_rejected. refused() types only FigError::Canceled and FigError::ExportRefused("canceled"). So this cancel becomes PlayFail { code: smart_native_refused or fig_native_refused, detail: native_rejected }. settle_export_job then settles JobOutcome::Failed(smart_native_refused), not Canceled. A cancel seen by the instance expansion cost walk is recorded as a loss and the mapping continues, so it also surfaces at the next check, which after the walk is a Folio validation.
findings.scenario: The process harness captures mid-transition (harness_drive_audio.rs:786-791: advance 175 ms, then capture_frame with a path), so the smart frame's to_native is on the capture path. A host raises the viewer's cancel from another thread while to_native is inside validate_document for the tween document. The capture replies code smart_native_refused with message native_rejected, the job counts show failed 1 and canceled 0, and an operator or model reads it as a mapping defect, not a cancel. prototype.start_session has the same window during the import's to_native (fig_native_refused).
findings.fix: Add FigError::NativeRejected(hsk_studio_folio::Code::Canceled) to the canceled arm at :95 (harness-view already depends on hsk-studio-folio). List it in the module doc and in refused()'s doc.
findings.test: Red first, in the prototype.rs tests module: refused("smart_native_refused", &FigError::NativeRejected(hsk_studio_folio::Code::Canceled)) gives ("canceled", "smart_native_refused"), and the same for fig_native_refused. It fails at 2adb7501 with ("smart_native_refused", "native_rejected"). A deterministic real-path test would need a hook between the walk and the validation; none exists, and adding one is not proposed.

answers.token_unchecked_paths: Cache hit: refused before the cache by the top check (:914; the warm-cache test pins it). After that check, cache hits run no further check (:798-799, :850-853). So a cancel raised from another thread after the top check, with every frame cached, is not seen by the render. For a capture with a path, the pre-write check (:136 in commands) catches it (see F2). For a no-path capture, the frame is returned, with no side effect and no job. Between frames, every cache miss starts with export_frame_pdf's entry check (interop-fig-native export.rs:767), so each new frame or overlay checks. Mid-render, the lowering checks per layer (export.rs:393), press finish checks (:815), and press's render back checks in parse and in its painter (press-write render.rs:113-115, :124, :157-159). Unchecked bounded steps: smart_document, plan_frame_exports, the cross-fade blend, and overlay compositing, all bounded by MAX_SCREEN_PIXELS or the document. Typing: one mapping gap in to_native's Folio validations (F1).
answers.partial_state: Cache: rendered and smart_cache are written only after a successful render back (:816-817, :871-872). A cancelled frame is never cached; frames finished before the cancel stay cached and valid. Session: start_session assigns v.prototype only after open_with succeeds. A cancelled start leaves no new session and keeps any prior one, as any import refusal did at the base. Capture file: the render and the encode happen before any byte; :136 checks before write_new or write_atomic; the after-admission test asserts no file and no temp. Job: settled once, canceled (doc_export.rs:982); the test asserts admitted 1, canceled 1, released 1, in_flight 0.
